sampling: first, passage-nearest, last source frame of every right proposal
review_rule: clear if both median non-ice fractions <= 0.25; otherwise cluttered; fewer than three distinct frames or no underpoint score remains unavailable
feature_scope: all 100 full-source right proposals, including the 20 right-only proposals source-classified at 5670–6670 s
limitations: The source classes are postproposal same-agent reviews of three frames, not independent physical throw labels.
The threshold and feature geometry were developed on earlier 2024 recordings, with Czechia among those sources; this Latvia score is a code transfer but not camera-family transfer.
A context score cannot recover a missed proposal or verify full cross-frame stone identity.
